race.description: New Membership Season Open Now 2YO Mdn Plate
race.comment: MARIA CLARA (6) showed tremendous pace to lead the field for home then was only claimed close to the line on debut over 1200m here last start. Sure to improve with that run under the belt and coming back to 1000m looks the perfect set-up. SUMMER SENSATION (9) returns for a second campaign off a 19-week spell. The best of three runs was a close fourth on debut over 1110m at Doomben against Saturday class opposition. Recent trial winner who can take this out with a similar first-up effort to last prep. SOVEREIGN STYLE (8) won a trial at this track recently and looks ready for a positive debut. SUNSET ADIOS (3) is trained here and is another first starter who can run well judging by his trial performances.
